verdict.rationale: Azure Cost Management documents budgets with alerts on actual or forecasted cost against a spending limit (azure-docs-13). The Cost Management APIs support programmatic cost and usage analysis (azure-docs-22, azure-docs-30). The pack contains no documented spend anomaly detection and no evidence these controls are on or easily set up from account creation. missing for 10: documented cost anomaly detection, evidence of day-one/default configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration that budget alerts prevent surprise bills.
